sources.title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of GPT-2 with LoRA - Keras
sources.snippet: In this example, we will explain LoRA in technical terms, show how the technical explanation translates to code, hack KerasHub's GPT-2 model and fine-tune it on the next token prediction task using LoRA. We will compare LoRA GPT-2 with a fully fine-tuned GPT-2 in terms of the quality of the generated text, training time and GPU memory usage.

sources.title: parameter_efficient_finetuning_of_gpt2_with_lora - Colab
sources.snippet: The LoRA equation is: output = W0x + b0 + BAx, where A and B are the rank-decomposition matrices. LoRA is based on the idea that updates to the weights of the pre-trained language model have a low "intrinsic rank" since pre-trained language models are over-parametrized.
